items.reason: Glioblastoma is never named in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or the arm label (only 'Recurrent Malignant Glioma' and 'WHO Grade 2 Glioma'), and entry requires an IDH1 mutation ('Patients With Tumors Harboring IDH1 Mutations'), so any glioma enrolled is IDH-mutant; §1.1 lists IDH-mutant glioma only under not_glioblastoma. Both values give the same exclusion reason (not_glioblastoma).

note: Excluded at S5 (not_glioblastoma), so downstream fields are descriptive only. basket proposed true because the record is a multi-cancer paediatric MATCH basket (coders split, priority 3); it has no effect once excluded. IDH1-mutation + ivosidenib is a genuine candidate match (not the IDH-wildtype diagnostic exception).
